sanskrit: kaśyapaś ca suparṇaś ca yan marīcyām atiṣṭhatām | suparṇaḥ pary avāpaśyat samudre bhūmim āvṛtām ||
english: Kaśyapa and Suparṇa both stood in the Marīci; Suparṇa looked about and saw the earth enveloped in the ocean.

sanskrit: yāṃ suparṇaḥ paryapaśyad antar mahaty arṇave | tāṃ sūkara tvaṃ māyayā triḥ samudrād ud ābharaḥ ||
english: That earth which Suparṇa beheld sunken within the great flood — thee, O Sūkara, by thy wizardry thou didst lift up thrice from the ocean.

sanskrit: yaṃ samudrād udabharo bhūmiṃ sūkara māyayā | saiṣā viṣasya dūṣaṇy asmai bhavatu bheṣajī ||
english: This earth which thou, O Sūkara, didst bring up from the ocean by thy wizardry — she is the corrupter of poison; let her be the remedy for this one.

sanskrit: acyutā hiraṇyena yā satye adhitiṣṭhati | tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare ||
english: She who, unshaken, stands upon the truth, clad in gold — from her, the all-sustaining, I draw forth the poison-destroyer.

sanskrit: yasyāḥ kulāyam ity ekā ||
english: She of whom one says: "whose nest is this" — [so is she named by one who knows].

sanskrit: yasyā bhūmyā upajīkā gṛhaṃ kṛṇvata ātmane | tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare ||
english: She of whose earth the crickets make a home for themselves — from her, the all-sustaining, I draw forth the poison-destroyer.

sanskrit: yas tvā bhūme 'nvavindad yas tvā bhūma udābharat | tayoḥ sahasradhāmann ahaṃ nāmāni jagrabha ||
english: He who found thee, O Earth; he who lifted thee up, O Earth — I have seized upon the names of those two, O thou of a thousand streams.

sanskrit: yāni ta indro akṛṇod bhūme nāmāni vṛtrahā | tāni te babhroḥ saṃ vidma sehaidhi viṣadūṣaṇī ||
english: The names which Indra the Vṛtra-slayer made for thee, O Earth — those names of thine, O tawny one, we know them fully; be thou the destroyer of poison!

sanskrit: yāni te marutaś cakrur yāni saptarṣayo viduḥ | viśva ādityā yāṃ viduḥ sā bhūmir viṣadūṣaṇī ||
english: Those that the Maruts fashioned for thee, those that the seven seers know, that which all the Ādityāḥ know — that Earth is the destroyer of poison.

sanskrit: sahasva yātudhānān sahasva yātudhānyaḥ | sahasva sarvā rakṣāṃsi sahamānāsy oṣadhe ||
english: Overpower the yātudhānas, overpower the yātudhānīs; overpower all the rākṣasas — thou art the overpowering one, O herb.

sanskrit: sahamāne sahasvati sahanty ahamuttare | utāham asmi sāsahiḥ sāsahe vaḥ sadānvāḥ ||
english: O overpowering one, O ever-victorious one — vanquishing, I am the superior. Moreover I am the conqueror; I, together with the ever-following ones, have conquered you.

sanskrit: yā sahamānā carasi sāsahāna ivarṣabhaḥ | sadānvāghnī rakṣoghnī sā tvam ugrāsy oṣadhe ||
english: Thou who movest as the overpowering one, like a bull that has conquered — destroyer of sadānvāḥ, destroyer of rākṣasas: thou, O herb, art terrible.

sanskrit: khele hai lambanastani naśyetaḥ prāmutaḥ pata | na tvām avivyacad iha- -ukṣeva śṛṅgavac chiraḥ ||
english: O Khelā with drooping breasts — flee hence, fly away from here! A head with horns like a bull here has not missed thee.

sanskrit: asuvāne bahuputre anantarve mahodari | pathāsmat satvare tvaṃ śarkarā bapsatī cara ||
english: O thou of no pressing, O thou of many sons, O thou with no entrails, O great-bellied one — depart quickly from us along the road, O gravel-devourer, roam on!

sanskrit: ye 'rāyāś caratha pākasyecchanta āsutim | tān agne kṛṣṇavartane tīkṣṇaśṛṅgodṛṣann ihi ||
english: Those misers who roam seeking the pressing of the fool — upon them, O Agni of the black track, sharp-horned, go goring!

sanskrit: ado yad dāru plavate sindhor madhye apūruṣam | tad ā rabhasva durhaṇo tena yāhi parastaram ||
english: That piece of wood which floats in the midst of the river, uninhabited by any person — grasp hold of that, O malevolent one, and go yonder beyond.

sanskrit: yasyā janitram iṣṭargā adṛṣṭāḥ krimayaḥ pluṣayaḥ | tasyai balāsapatnyai namas kṛṇomi kuṣṭhyai ||
english: She whose birth-place the desired ones have traversed — the unseen worms, the scorching insects — to her, the consort of Balāsa, to the kuṣṭha-afflicting one, I make obeisance.

sanskrit: śarvaputre bhavapatni yātubhrātri sadānve | tasyāddhi putrān bhrātṝṃś ca yatra tvā vinayāmasi ||
english: O daughter of Śarva, O wife of Bhava, O sister of the yātu-demons, O ever-following one — feed upon her sons and brothers there where we conduct thee.

sanskrit: vṛṣāyam aṃśur vṛṣabhāya gṛhyate vṛṣāyam ugro nṛcakṣase | divyo naryo 'cikradan mahan nāmarṣabhasya yat kakut ||
english: This soma-stalk is pressed for the bull; for the bull it is taken up, fierce for the one who beholds men. The divine, manly one has cried aloud — great is the name of the bull, for such is his hump.

sanskrit: viṣuvān viṣṇo bhava tvaṃ yo nṛpatir mama | atho indra iva devebhyo vi bravītu janebhyaḥ ||
english: Be thou the equinox, O Viṣṇu — thou who art the lord of men for me. Moreover, even as Indra among the gods, let him proclaim himself among the peoples.

sanskrit: manuṣyebhyo vi bravītu sajūr indreṇa medinā | agniś ca tubhyaṃ sāhantyo rāṣṭraṃ vaiśvānaro dadhat ||
english: Let him proclaim himself among men, in concert with Indra the ally; and may Agni Vaiśvānara, the overcomer, confer upon thee the kingdom.

sanskrit: yasyāyaṃ bhāga ṛṣabha indrāya pariṇīyate | sa hantu śatrūn āyato atho hantu parāyataḥ ||
english: He whose share — this bull — is led around for Indra: let him smite enemies on the approach, and let him smite them on the departure.

sanskrit: sa hantā śatror bhavatu hantā bhavatu dodhatām | viśām aha praṇīr ayad agram udbhindatām asat ||
english: Let him be the slayer of the enemy, the slayer of those who rage; let him be the leader of the clans, going at the fore among those who break forth.

sanskrit: āyuṣmantaṃ varcasvantam atho adhipatiṃ viśām | asyāḥ pṛthivyāś cettāram imam indrarṣabhaṃ kṛṇu ||
english: Make this bull of Indra long-lived, full of brilliance, and also the overlord of the clans, the master of this earth.

sanskrit: yaḥ suśṛṅgaḥ sukakudaḥ kalyāṇo barhir āsadat | kārṣīvaṇaprajānena ṛṣabheṇa yajāmahe ||
english: He who is of fine horns, of fine hump, auspicious — he has seated himself upon the sacrificial grass; with the bull born of farmer-folk we offer worship.

sanskrit: ṛṣabheṇa yajamānā akrūreṇeva sarpiṣā | mṛdhaś ca sarvā indreṇa pṛtanāś ca sahāmahe ||
english: Offering worship with the bull, as if with gentle ghee, we overcome with Indra all scorners and all battle-hosts.

sanskrit: yaṃ tubhyaṃ bhāgam ṛṣabhaṃ devāḥ kevalyaṃ daduḥ | tena vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaḥ śatrūṃś ca jahy āhave ||
english: The bull which the gods gave thee as thy exclusive share — with him strike down the Vṛtra-foes and smite the enemies in battle.

sanskrit: jahi śatrūn vi mṛdho nudasva kṛṣyāḥ saṃbhūto asi vīryāvān | indrāya bhāgaṃ pari tvā nayāma urur no loko apṛtanyo astu ||
english: Smite the enemies, thrust aside the scorners — thou art arisen, endowed with virile power. We lead thee around as Indra's share; let our world be wide, free from adversaries.

sanskrit: ghṛtavṛddha ghṛtāhuta sahasraśṛṅga suṣṭuta | ghṛtāhavana dīdihi ||
english: O thou grown great with ghee, fed with ghee, of a thousand horns, well praised — O thou invoked with ghee, blaze forth!

sanskrit: yo ghṛtenābhighārita ugro jaitrāya tiṣṭhasi | sa naḥ saṅkāsu pāraya pṛtanāsāhyeṣu ca ||
english: Thou who, anointed with ghee, dost stand fierce for victory — do thou carry us through the straits and through the overpowering of battle-hosts.
